summary.what_it_does:
Notesnook is a note-taking app whose notes are encrypted before they are synced to its servers, with the company stating it cannot read them. It supports rich editing including tables, task lists, outlines, code blocks, maths formulas, Markdown and attachments. Users can add a second vault password to lock specific notes, lock the app with a fingerprint, PIN or password, and set repeating reminders. The page also describes linking notes together, clipping web articles without ads, publishing a single note as a password-protected web page, and receiving notes from Zapier, IFTTT or custom scripts via an inbox key.</available>
